H1.metric: per-commit thread CPU ns, median over each process's timed commits

G3.metric: per-commit wall ns, median over each process's timed commits

G4.samples: per verify run, the T per-commit net values of each stratum's timed commits

G5.samples: per verify run, the T per-commit net values of each stratum's timed commits

appends.condition: pack and index growth equal the encoded appends
appends.asserted_by: the verify child at every commit; a violation fails the child

model.condition: the sealed metadata objects equal the writer model's bytes
model.asserted_by: the verify child at every commit; a violation fails the child

crossover.definition: per R stratum over its timed verify commits: the measured median metadata bytes, the V1 manifest bytes 96 + 56 * (history + commit + 1) of the same commits, and for V2 the smallest retained-entry count whose V1 manifest exceeds the measured V2 median

trusted_effects.condition: the publication effects are the trusted effects
trusted_effects.asserted_by: the verify child at every commit; a violation fails the child

G10.reason: each control is its own --controls population; see that population's analysis.json
